headline: Brazil Government Considers Fiscal Framework Adjustments
summary: The Brazilian government is evaluating changes to its fiscal framework that would allow spending freezes to lower the federal spending ceiling in future years. No final decision has been reached.
why: Fiscal rules are critical for maintaining investor confidence in Brazil's debt sustainability and inflation control.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Changes to fiscal rules impact sovereign credit risk and currency valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Speculation regarding fiscal policy changes directly influences market expectations for government spending and debt management.
